retrieved_context: Tom Clancy: Thomas Leo "Tom" Clancy Jr. (April 12, 1947 – October 1, 2013) was an American novelist best known for his technically detailed espionage and military-science story lines set during and after the Cold War.  Seventeen of his novels were bestsellers, and more than 100 million copies of his books are in print.  His name was also used on movie scripts written by ghost writers, nonfiction books on military subjects, and video games.  He was a part-owner of the Baltimore Orioles and vice-chairman of their community activities and public affairs committees.

The Sum of All Fears: The Sum of All Fears is a best-selling thriller novel by Tom Clancy and part of the Jack Ryan universe.  It was the fourth of Clancy's "Jack Ryan" books to be turned into a film (2002).
Jack Ryan (character): Dr. John Patrick "Jack" Ryan Sr., KCVO (Hon.), Ph.D. is a fictional character created by Tom Clancy who appears in many of his novels and their respective film adaptations.
